description: Election Commission - Declare as members R. Sivarajah for Trincomalee Town and Gravets P/S, S. Kawignan for Valvettithurai U/C, S. Udayarani for Vavuniya North P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Trincomalee Town and Gravets Pradeshiya Sabha, Valvettithurai Urban Council, and Vavuniya North Pradeshiya Sabha) due to resignations, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of newly selected members to fill these electoral vacancies, which falls under election-related matters and processes. This fits Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it concerns electoral processes at the local government level, including candidate nominations and declarations to fill vacant elected positions.
